body.text: Which FDA/CE-approved implant brands (Mentor, Motiva) should be documented with serial cards?

Patients undergoing breast augmentation or implant-assisted lift in Türkiye should confirm their surgeon uses internationally regulated, FDA- and CE-approved silicone implants—most commonly Mentor (MemoryGel and MemoryShape) or Motiva (SmoothSilk Round and Ergonomix)—and must receive official manufacturer serial cards and box stickers listing exact lot numbers, volume, and profile before leaving the hospital.

According to the [FDA Approved Breast Implants Labeling directory](https://www.fda.gov/medical-devices/breast-implants/labeling-approved-breast-implants), Mentor MemoryGel (P030053) and Mentor MemoryShape (P060028) carry long-standing FDA Premarket Approvals, while Motiva SmoothSilk Round and Ergonomix received [FDA Premarket Approval (P230005)](https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/scripts/cdrh/cfdocs/cfpma/pma.cfm?id=P230005) in September 2024 alongside existing European CE marking. Keeping your physical serial card and photographing the packaging labels ensures any home-country clinician can identify the exact device during future imaging or [postmarket safety reviews](https://www.fda.gov/medical-devices/breast-implants/breast-implant-postmarket-safety-information).

body.text: How many days in Istanbul are needed before fit-to-fly clearance?

For primary breast augmentation, breast lift (mastopexy), or breast reduction, plan 6 to 8 nights in Istanbul—or 8 to 10 nights for combined lift-and-implant or larger reduction procedures. Both the [NHS cosmetic surgery abroad guide](https://www.nhs.uk/tests-and-treatments/cosmetic-procedures/advice/cosmetic-surgery-abroad/) and [BAPRAS patient advice](https://www.bapras.org.uk/public/patient-information/cosmetic-surgery/cosmetic-surgery-abroad) advise waiting at least 5 to 7 days after breast surgery before flying.

A typical timeline includes Day 1 arrival and pre-operative blood work, Day 2 surgery with one night in hospital, Days 3 to 5 hotel recovery with a mid-week dressing check, and Day 6 or 7 final incision review and written fit-to-fly clearance. If you are combining breast surgery with abdominal work, see our guide on [mommy makeover and abdominoplasty logistics in Türkiye](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/blog/mommy-makeover-turkey-logistics).
Why should surgery always take place in a full-service accredited hospital?

Breast augmentation, lift, and reduction require general anaesthesia and carry rare but time-sensitive risks—such as post-operative bleeding (haematoma), airway issues, or adverse anaesthetic reactions—that can only be managed safely in a full-service hospital equipped with an intensive care unit (ICU), blood-bank access, and 24-hour specialist anaesthesiology teams.

The [ISAPS Medical Tourism Awareness guide](https://www.isaps.org/media/dydp5pmm/montserrat_medical-tourism-english.pdf) emphasizes confirming that the surgical facility is approved by national medical authorities. Before travelling, verify that the hospital holds a [Turkish Ministry of Health International Health Tourism Authorization Certificate](https://shgmturizmdb.saglik.gov.tr/EN-69289/healthcare-providers-with-international-health-tourism-authorization-certificates.html) and never accept surgery in an unaccredited outpatient office suite.

body.text: What companion support is essential in the first 72 hours?

During the first 72 hours after breast surgery, chest tightness and arm-lifting restrictions make everyday tasks—opening heavy hotel doors, lifting water bottles, reaching overhead, washing hair, or managing timed medications—difficult to handle alone. Having a trusted companion or pre-arranged practical assistance prevents accidental strain on fresh incisions and sutures.

faq.q: Can I ask to see my sealed implant boxes before surgery?
faq.a: Yes. Reputable hospitals allow you to confirm the brand and receive the official manufacturer stickers and patient serial cards immediately after the operation.

faq.q: Why does a breast reduction or lift sometimes require a longer stay than augmentation?
faq.a: Breast reductions and lifts involve longer incisions and more extensive internal tissue reshaping, which may require extra wound checks or drain monitoring before fit-to-fly clearance.

faq.q: Can I carry my own cabin suitcase on the flight home?
faq.a: No. Lifting heavy bags overhead strains pectoral muscles and incisions; check your luggage and arrange airport porter or wheelchair assistance in advance.

faq.q: Are silicone breast implants safe to fly with shortly after surgery?
faq.a: Cabin pressure does not rupture modern silicone gel implants, but flying too soon increases swelling, discomfort, and DVT risk—always follow your surgeon's clearance date.

faq.q: How can I check if a Turkish hospital is legally authorised for international patients?
faq.a: You can verify authorisation through the [Turkish Ministry of Health Health Tourism Department](https://shgmturizmdb.saglik.gov.tr/EN-69289/healthcare-providers-with-international-health-tourism-authorization-certificates.html) and cross-check international accreditations such as Joint Commission International (JCI).
